entity.summary: Self-custody hardware-wallet company focused on the air-gapped NGRAVE ZERO signing device and related backup products.
entity.notes: First-party company material states that NGRAVE was founded in 2018.

products.summary: Air-gapped NGRAVE hardware wallet designed to keep private keys offline and sign without network connectivity.
products.notes: Current first-party product page establishes NGRAVE ZERO as an active purchasable product; exact initial release date remains unresolved in this batch.

events.title: NGRAVE announced ZERO was ready to ship
events.description: NGRAVE announced that its ZERO hardware wallet was ready to ship and would soon be in the hands of backers.
events.notes: This records the first-party ready-to-ship milestone only. It does not infer general retail availability or an exact first-customer delivery date.

evidence.title: NGRAVE ZERO awarded Crypto Wallet Solution of the Year
evidence.notes: First-party NGRAVE material identifies the company as founded in 2018 and describes ZERO as its flagship hardware wallet.

evidence.title: NGRAVE ZERO
evidence.notes: Current first-party product page establishes the active NGRAVE ZERO air-gapped hardware-wallet boundary.

evidence.title: We are ready to Ship!
evidence.notes: First-party NGRAVE post dated 2021-11-02 states ZERO was ready to ship and would soon be in the hands of backers.

evidence.title: NGRAVE ZERO Firmware Update
evidence.notes: Official firmware-update surface and release notes for NGRAVE ZERO establish an active maintained firmware/support path.
